name: Niconico Chokaigi
blurb: Dwango's massive internet-culture festival at Makuhari Messe, blending livestreamers, VTubers, vocaloid music and otaku fan culture.

editions.evidence: Kadokawa Group press release: 'また、2027年4月には「ニコニコ超会議2027」を開催することをお知らせします。' (Niconico Chokaigi 2027 will be held in April 2027).

notes: Only the month has been officially confirmed so far. Some entertainment-news sites (e.g. PASH! Plus) report specific dates of April 24-25, 2027, but I could not verify an exact day range directly from an official source within budget, so it is recorded at month granularity instead. Venue is given as Makuhari Messe by long-standing pattern (every edition has been held there), but the 2027 venue was not explicitly restated in the official announcement text I could access.
